description: This file defines types and interfaces related to the server-side context of a browser automation system, including runtime states, server state, profile actions, route context, and profile status.

methods.name: ensureBrowserAvailable
methods.description: Ensures that a browser instance is available and ready.

methods.name: ensureTabAvailable
methods.description: Ensures that a specific tab is available, optionally targeting a specific tab ID.

methods.name: isHttpReachable
methods.description: Checks if the browser's HTTP interface is reachable within an optional timeout.

methods.name: isReachable
methods.description: Checks overall reachability of the browser.

methods.name: listTabs
methods.description: Lists all open tabs in the browser.

methods.name: openTab
methods.description: Opens a new tab with the specified URL.

methods.name: focusTab
methods.description: Focuses on a specific tab by its target ID.

methods.name: closeTab
methods.description: Closes the tab with the specified target ID.

methods.name: stopRunningBrowser
methods.description: Stops the currently running browser instance.

methods.name: resetProfile
methods.description: Resets the browser profile, optionally moving data from one location to another.

calls: Promise<{moved: boolean; from: string; to?: string}>
